data.business: Persistent Systems Limited is a software and IT consulting organisation operating with more than 27,500 employees across 21 countries (0.1, 0.7). data.narrative: Both the annual report and management calls highlight the company's steady expansion in headcount and revenue scale (0.7, 1.6, 2.2, 3.14). The annual report focuses on capital management objectives, business continuity frameworks, and risk mitigation across foreign exchange and investments (0.16, 0.17, 0.19, 0.2). Recent concalls shift emphasis toward major strategic deal wins, platform innovations, and the planned acquisition of Nagarro (1.13, 1.18, 2.11, 4.10).

bull.point: Persistent Systems achieved full-year FY26 revenue of USD 1.65 billion and holds a historical five-year CAGR of 23.9% (2.23, 3.5).
The BFSI vertical demonstrated strong performance with full-year FY26 revenue growth of 28.4% year-on-year and an annualized run rate of USD 600 million (3.8, 3.9).
The company has strong technical capabilities, holding over 58,000 AI certifications and filing 105 patents for its SASVA platform (1.13, 4.10).
Operational efficiency remains strong with utilization reaching 85.8% and tools driving a 150 basis point margin improvement (1.7, 4.14).

bear.point: Revenue generation carries customer concentration risk, as the top 100 customers provide 82% of total revenue (4.13).
The planned Nagarro acquisition introduces significant leverage, funded via bridge financing from Barclays and inheriting Nagarro's net debt of around €267 million (2.11, 2.13, 2.14).
The company faces foreign currency exposure risks, reflected by a debit balance of INR 1,676.01 Million in its Forward Cover Reserve as of March 31, 2026 (0.8, 0.17).
Employee attrition remains a concern, ranging between 11.9% and 13.5% on a trailing 12-month basis across recent quarters (1.8, 3.4, 4.5).

data.balance: The company has no outstanding bank borrowings, with principal liquidity sourced from cash and cash equivalents and operating cash flows (0.20).
